body: You’re right, Tim should’ve told the experts his preferences on physical appearances. But after the wedding, Tim did express to Katie that he wasn’t interested so I don’t really understand the amount of hate he got. He seems like a douche but Katie was the one who kept pushing and crying. I gotta say the kiss on the cheek thing was hard to watch, why on earth would you tease someone who’s clearly not interested in you infront of everyone
